summary.text: Peerless Trojan whom Atreus' son Agamemnon first smote from above in the shoulder when the king leapt upon him with sharp spear — Apollodorus names a Deïopites among Priam's sons by other women.

story.text: When the Trojans pressed around Odysseus dear to Zeus, Agamemnon came on like a lion and first smote peerless Deïopites from above in the shoulder, leaping upon him with sharp spear; and thereafter he slew Thoön and Eunomus, and then Chersidamas.
